description: Inspection commands (determinex evidence validate, determinex config show/doctor, determinex status) are verified read-only and must not mutate evidence or corpus files.
invariants: determinex evidence validate does not create, modify, or delete any files in assurance/evidence/
determinex config show does not write to scripts/, assurance/, or corpus/
determinex status does not call any corpus write method
read_only_context() exports DETERMINEX_NO_CORPUS_WRITE=1 inside the context
read_only_context() restores the previous env value on exit (including on exception)
read_only_context() is composable (nested contexts work correctly)
